verdict.rationale: Mailchimp Transactional documents per-message hard-bounce, soft-bounce, spam-complaint and reject events delivered via webhooks, plus a rejection denylist/allowlist. That is a first-party, per-send bounce and complaint signal, though it is developer-facing rather than a marketer report. The marketing-campaign report evidence covers only opens and clicks, and nothing in the pack shows blocklist monitoring or guidance when deliverability degrades. missing for 10: bounce/complaint metrics in marketer-facing campaign reports, blocklist (IP/domain) signals, actionable deliverability-degradation guidance or alerts, independent corroboration.
